國民生活時間調査 農業世帶編 1943

Kokumin seikatsu jikan chōsa: ippan chōsa hōkoku, nōgyō setai hen (National Time-Use Survey, General Survey Report: Farm Households), 昭和18年1月
日本放送協會 (Japan Broadcasting Corporation, NHK), 東京, 1943

Every table is transcribed: the 14 national and 40 regional time-of-day tables, the four time-budget tables, the 40 regional listening-suitability tables and the small tables and village list in the outline. The 14 listening-suitability charts (時刻別聽取適否參考圖) print no figures and are not reproduced; the prose is not transcribed. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye. Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the row add to 100, that reading is used and noted. Rows that do not add to 100 as printed (rounding, and some dropped or wrong digits in the type) are kept as printed and noted. 88 of about 219,000 cells could not be read and are marked [?].
